title: OVH releases Olala Mini 7A1B, a small MoE that activates about 1B parameters per request and runs agentic tasks without a GPU
summary: OVHcloud's Olala v1.0 mini (7B total, about 1B active, 32K context) is published on Hugging Face with a hosted playground; the post cites 220-380 tokens/s on B300 GPUs. A 128K v1.1 is promised but not shipped.

appearances.title: Olala mini releases a 7B Mamba-attention model
appearances.summary: OVH aiLLM released Olala mini, a 7B-total, 1B-active model trained on 13T tokens. It mixes Mamba-3 layers with grouped differential attention, scalable softmax, and a smaller factored KV cache, and the weights, demo, and tech report are public. Albert Gu amplified the release.
